evals.prompt: 我在 WSL 里开发，现在需要调用 Windows 上的 Visio COM 接口来自动化生成图表，应该怎么操作？
evals.expected_output: 应该建议使用 powershell.exe 作为桥接，提供具体的命令示例，解释 WSLInterop 机制，并说明 COM 对象不能跨边界传递

assertions.name: mentions_powershell_bridge
assertions.prompt: Check if the response mentions using powershell.exe as a bridge from WSL to Windows

assertions.name: mentions_com_limitation
assertions.prompt: Check if the response mentions that COM objects cannot cross the WSL-Windows boundary

evals.prompt: WSL 里运行 python 脚本提示 ImportError: No module named 'win32com'，但我明明在 Windows 上装了这个包，怎么回事？
evals.expected_output: 应该解释 WSL 和 Windows 是两个独立环境，建议通过 PowerShell 调用 Windows 侧的 Python，或提供替代方案

assertions.name: explains_environment_separation
assertions.prompt: Check if the response explains that WSL Linux and Windows are separate environments

assertions.name: suggests_windows_python
assertions.prompt: Check if the response suggests using Windows-side Python via PowerShell

evals.prompt: 能不能在 WSL 里用 PowerShell 启动一个 Windows 上的后台服务，并且之后还能停止它？
evals.expected_output: 应该提供 Start-Process 启动和基于 WMI 命令行的精确进程停止示例，并提醒使用 PID 文件管理进程生命周期

assertions.name: provides_start_example
assertions.prompt: Check if the response provides a Start-Process example for starting a background service

assertions.name: provides_stop_example
assertions.prompt: Check if the response provides a Stop-Process or WMI-based example for stopping the service

assertions.name: warns_about_limitations
assertions.prompt: Check if the response warns about process management limitations and suggests PID file or command-line matching

evals.prompt: 我在 WSL 里执行 powershell.exe 报错 Exec format error，怎么解决？
evals.expected_output: 应该解释 WSLInterop 未注册，提供注册命令，并建议配置 /etc/wsl.conf 持久化

assertions.name: explains_wslinterop
assertions.prompt: Check if the response explains WSLInterop and why the error occurs

assertions.name: provides_fix_command
assertions.prompt: Check if the response provides the binfmt_misc registration command to fix the issue

evals.prompt: 请帮我写一个脚本，在 WSL 里调用 Windows 上的 Python 执行 pywin32 操作，并把结果传回 WSL
evals.expected_output: 应该建议使用 Python 脚本文件模式，展示如何在 Windows 侧生成 JSON 输出，以及如何在 WSL 侧解析

assertions.name: recommends_script_file_pattern
assertions.prompt: Check if the response recommends using a Python script file (Pattern 3) rather than inline commands

assertions.name: mentions_json_for_data_exchange
assertions.prompt: Check if the response mentions using JSON for structured data exchange between Windows and WSL

evals.prompt: 我在 WSL 里需要执行一个复杂的 PowerShell 命令，里面嵌套了很多引号，一直报错，有没有更好的办法？
evals.expected_output: 应该建议使用 -EncodedCommand 模式，将命令 Base64 编码后执行，彻底解决引号转义问题

assertions.name: mentions_encoded_command
assertions.prompt: Check if the response mentions using -EncodedCommand with Base64-encoded UTF-16LE to solve quote escaping

assertions.name: provides_encoding_example
assertions.prompt: Check if the response shows how to encode a command with iconv and base64

evals.prompt: 怎么从 WSL 中读取和修改 Windows 注册表？我想查一下安装了哪些软件。
evals.expected_output: 应该提供 Get-ItemProperty 读取注册表的示例，展示如何列出 HKLM 下的已安装软件，以及 Set-ItemProperty 修改注册表的方法

assertions.name: mentions_registry_read
assertions.prompt: Check if the response provides Get-ItemProperty examples for reading Windows Registry from WSL

assertions.name: mentions_uninstall_path
assertions.prompt: Check if the response mentions the Uninstall registry path for listing installed software

evals.prompt: 我想从 WSL 获取 Windows 系统的硬件信息，比如 CPU 型号、内存大小、硬盘容量，怎么做？

assertions.prompt: Check if the response mentions Get-CimInstance for querying WMI/CIM classes

assertions.name: covers_hardware_classes
assertions.prompt: Check if the response covers Win32_Processor, Win32_ComputerSystem, or Win32_LogicalDisk for hardware info

evals.prompt: 能不能从 WSL 调用 Windows 的原生 Win32 API？比如弹出一个 MessageBox 通知？

assertions.name: mentions_add_type
assertions.prompt: Check if the response mentions Add-Type for compiling C# code in PowerShell to call Win32 API

assertions.name: provides_pinvoke_example
assertions.prompt: Check if the response provides a DllImport example for calling a Win32 function (e.g., user32.dll MessageBox)

evals.prompt: 怎么在 WSL 终端里把输出结果复制到 Windows 剪贴板？或者读取 Windows 剪贴板的内容？

assertions.prompt: Check if the response shows how to send WSL output to Windows clipboard (clip.exe or Set-Clipboard)

assertions.name: mentions_clipboard_win_to_wsl
assertions.prompt: Check if the response shows how to read Windows clipboard from WSL (Get-Clipboard)

evals.prompt: 我想从 WSL 查看 Windows 的事件日志，排查一下系统错误，该怎么做？

assertions.name: mentions_event_log
assertions.prompt: Check if the response mentions Get-WinEvent for querying Windows Event Logs

assertions.name: provides_filter_example
assertions.prompt: Check if the response shows how to filter events by log name, level, or time range

evals.prompt: 我想在 WSL 里创建一个 Windows 定时任务，每天凌晨自动运行一个 Python 脚本，怎么操作？

assertions.name: mentions_scheduled_task
assertions.prompt: Check if the response mentions Register-ScheduledTask or schtasks for creating Windows scheduled tasks

assertions.name: provides_task_creation_example
assertions.prompt: Check if the response provides a concrete example of creating a scheduled task with trigger and action

evals.prompt: 我想从 WSL 快速查一下 Windows 的注册表，不需要复杂的 JSON 输出，有没有比 powershell.exe 更快的方法？
evals.expected_output: 应该建议使用 reg.exe 直接读取注册表（Channel B），说明它比 PowerShell 快 3-5 倍，并给出 reg query 的具体语法

assertions.prompt: Check if the response mentions using reg.exe directly from WSL without PowerShell as a faster alternative

assertions.name: provides_reg_query_example
assertions.prompt: Check if the response provides a reg.exe query command example

evals.prompt: 我在 WSL 里生成了一个 PDF 报告，想用 Windows 上默认的 PDF 阅读器打开它，怎么做最简单？

assertions.name: mentions_wslview_or_open

evals.prompt: 怎么从 WSL 管理 Windows 的服务？比如启动和停止 DHCP 服务。

assertions.prompt: Check if the response mentions sc.exe as a direct way to control Windows services from WSL

assertions.name: provides_dual_channel_option

evals.prompt: 我想计算一个 Windows 文件的 SHA256 哈希值，在 WSL 里怎么做？
